## MG Quarto guide
<center>
![](images/quarto_quarters.png){style="width:100px"}
</center>
<br>
A quick and dirty guide on how I use quarto to make websites. It is primarily for my use but if someone else finds it I hope it will also proof useful.

Link: [https://m-gemmell.github.io/quarto_guide](https://m-gemmell.github.io/quarto_guide)

## NEOF Tidyverse

A resource for the R Tidyverse suite of packages. It is intended as a quick one-stop reference for the various tidyverse packages and their functions, also known as a cookbook.

Link: [https://neof-workshops.github.io/Tidyverse/](https://neof-workshops.github.io/Tidyverse/)
